release_notes: Fix a connection storm that froze the app within ~15 seconds of launch on any LAN where two or more machines still held the same station label (the default for a fresh install is 'Room 1', so a multi-station office installing the app for the first time would always trip it). The old server-side duplicate-label handling kicked the existing socket whenever a new hello arrived with a label already in use, and MessageClient reconnected instantly on graceful close, so peers with matching labels drove each other through a sub-millisecond connect/kick/reconnect cycle that spawned hundreds of _handle_client threads and pegged the main thread at 100%+ CPU recomputing button geometry on every presence broadcast. MessageServer now keeps the existing socket and refuses the duplicate hello, holding the rejected connection for 3 seconds before close so older peers without client-side backoff can't retry-flood. MessageClient now sleeps 3 seconds before every reconnect (was only on exception). Also removes a redundant NSRunLoop runUntilDate_ pump that was added alongside the native macOS menu-bar status item: modern TkAqua drives the AppKit run loop from its own mainloop, so the explicit 200 ms pump was unnecessary and triggered a fatal PyEval_RestoreThread / GIL-state assertion on some macOS 15.x installs.
